candidate_policy: clean-lineage V8 fallback rank0, fixed for all queries
data: SEL-C0 clean-train 2032 queries; exact-prefix cache for targets only; frozen clean V13 question/packet embeddings for features
roles: hash folds0-3 train (1421 queries); previously design-exposed fold4 diagnostic (611 queries)
model: 128-hidden MLP on query, selected-packet mean, query-product, normalized depth, and normalized prefix tokens; emits five level-by-prefix scores
objective: structured negative log probability of all minimum-cumulative-token fidelity-valid monotone stop vectors, with partition over every monotone vector; incomplete-order queries excluded from gradient and retained in evaluation
inference: Viterbi over nondecreasing prefix depths and attainable levels only; no exact fidelity or oracle path in inference
evaluation: per-anchor success, Complete, 0.90, legal cumulative tokens and regret on Complete, compared with same-order oracle; no threshold or checkpoint selection
